proves.claim: A merge recorded through the live-wired landing table ten minutes after its commit carries detail.mergedAt as the commit's committer time while event_at stays the record time.

moves.io-landing.merged-at-commit-time.why: Without this case the timeline would keep charging landing lag from the record time.

proves.claim: Replay of a merged event recorded before the merged-at engine leaf still agrees with the landing table.

moves.io-landing.merged-at-replay.why: Without this case an older merged event would show as a replay difference.
